question.question: After removing a ruin last item, what happens to its building slot, and can ordinary building placement remove a ruin instead?

expected.expected_answer: Remove ruin and slot becomes open. Ordinary placement cannot remove ruin; ruins removable only explicitly, and building needs open slot.

source_passages.section: Actions — Shared movement, crafting and battle — ruins
source_passages.quotation: Clearings have fox, rabbit or mouse suit and limited building slots. Buildings require open slots; tokens do not occupy these. Ruins block their slots and can be removed only when explicitly allowed. A forest is enclosed by printed paths and clearings; it is adjacent to clearings touching it without crossing a printed path and to forests separated by just one printed path. Winter's river also divides forests. (2.2–2.4, M.1–2.)
- **Explore:** Exhaust torch in ruin's clearing. Take one hidden item face up into Satchel or track; score one VP if an item taken. Remove ruin when its last item is taken, freeing the building slot.

answer.ruling: Explore the ruin by exhausting a torch in its clearing. When its last item is taken, remove the ruin, which frees the building slot.
Ordinary building placement cannot remove a ruin. Ruins block their slots and may be removed only when explicitly allowed; the supplied rule permits removal when Explore takes the ruin’s last item.
